verses.text: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
"Stand at the gate of the LORD's house and announce this message there: 'Listen to the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the LORD.
This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Change your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.
Do not trust in lies that say, "This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD!"
If you truly change your ways and your actions, and treat each other fairly,
if you do not treat foreigners, orphans, and widows cruelly, if you do not kill innocent people in this place, and if you do not follow other gods and hurt yourselves,
then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors forever and ever.
But look, you are trusting in lies that are worthless.
You steal, murder, commit adultery, make false promises, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods you have not known.
Then you come and stand before me in this house that is called by my name, and say, "We are safe!" just so you can keep doing all these disgusting things.
Has this house that is called by my name become a hiding place for robbers in your eyes? Look, I have seen it myself,' says the LORD.
'Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a home for my name. See what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.
You have done all these things,' says the LORD. 'I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen. I called you, but you did not answer.
So what I did to Shiloh I will now do to this house that is called by my name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.
I will throw you out of my sight, just as I threw out all your relatives, the people of Ephraim.'
So do not pray for these people, Jeremiah. Do not cry out or pray for them. Do not beg me, for I will not listen to you.
Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to make me angry.
But am I the one they are hurting?" says the LORD. "Are they not hurting themselves, to their own shame?"

So this is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, my anger and fury will be poured out on this place, on people and animals, on the trees of the field and the crops of the land. It will burn and not be put out."
This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices.
This is what I commanded them: 'Obey me, and I will be your God, and you will be my people. Walk in all the ways I command you, so that it will go well with you.'
But they did not listen or pay attention. They followed their own plans and their stubborn, evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
From the day your ancestors left Egypt until today, I have sent you my servants the prophets, again and again, day after day.
But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stubborn and did even worse than their ancestors.
When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
So say to them, 'This is the nation that has not obeyed the LORD its God or accepted correction. Truth has disappeared. It is no longer heard from their lips.'
Cut off your hair and throw it away. Sing a sad song on the bare hilltops. For the LORD has rejected and left this generation that has made him angry.
The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes," says the LORD. "They have set up their disgusting idols in the house that is called by my name and made it unclean.
They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire. I never commanded this, and it never even entered my mind.

So look, the days are coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom. They will call it the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
Then the dead bodies of this people will become food for the birds of the sky and the wild animals, and no one will scare them away.
I will put an end to the sounds of joy and gladness in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, the voices of the bride and bridegroom. For the land will become a wasteland."
